items.exampleEn: He smiled wickedly as he hid his sister's shoes.
items.exampleZh: 他一邊藏起他姊妹的鞋子，一邊壞壞地笑著。
items.glossZh: 頑皮使壞地；極其（好笑等）；邪惡地

items.exampleEn: "I told you so," she said smugly.
items.exampleZh: 「我早就跟你說了吧。」她得意洋洋地說。
items.glossZh: 沾沾自喜地；得意洋洋地

items.exampleEn: The tired runner gamely finished the race in last place.
items.exampleZh: 那位疲憊的跑者不服輸地跑完全程，拿了最後一名。

items.exampleEn: The hotel staff were refreshingly honest about the noise.
items.exampleZh: 飯店員工對噪音問題坦白得令人耳目一新。
items.glossZh: 令人耳目一新地；難得地

items.exampleEn: As a headstrong teenager, he ignored all advice.
items.exampleZh: 他十幾歲時固執任性，什麼建議都不聽。
items.glossZh: 固執任性的；剛愎自用的

items.exampleEn: Some of the song's lyrics are too raunchy for the radio.
items.exampleZh: 這首歌有些歌詞太粗俗露骨，不適合在電台播放。

items.exampleEn: Waiting for the exam results was torturous.
items.exampleZh: 等待考試結果真是折磨人。

items.exampleEn: The company is known for its ruthlessness toward competitors.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司以對競爭對手毫不留情聞名。

items.sentenceEn: The children gamely tried every strange dish at the party.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們勇敢地嘗試了派對上每一道奇怪的菜。

items.audioEn: After the long, torturous climb, the view from the top made it all worthwhile.
items.audioZh: 經過漫長又折磨人的攀爬，山頂的景色讓一切都值得了。
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得爬山的過程怎麼樣？
options: It was short and easy for everyone
It was very hard and painful
It was boring because there was nothing to see

items.sentenceEn: He leaned back smugly after answering the question correctly.
items.sentenceZh: 他答對問題後，得意洋洋地往後一靠。

items.sentenceEn: The new cafe is refreshingly quiet compared with the busy shops nearby.
items.sentenceZh: 和附近熱鬧的店比起來，這家新咖啡館安靜得令人耳目一新。

items.stemEn: My ____ daughter refuses to wear a coat, even in the middle of winter.
items.stemZh: 我那固執任性的女兒，就算在寒冬也不肯穿外套。

items.stemEn: Even after falling twice, the young dancer ____ got up and finished her show.
items.stemZh: 即使跌倒了兩次，那位年輕舞者還是勇敢地站起來，跳完了表演。

items.passageEn: Last month, my cousin Ivy entered a comedy contest in Taipei. She is headstrong, so when friends told her to change her act, she refused. The first round was torturous: the microphone kept cutting out, and the audience grew impatient. Ivy gamely carried on, telling her stories without it. Many other acts were provocative or even raunchy, so the judges found her clean, wickedly funny jokes refreshingly different. In the second round, they cut half of the performers with complete ruthlessness. One rival smiled smugly when he got through, but he lost to Ivy in the final.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我的表親 Ivy 參加了台北的一場喜劇比賽。她個性固執，朋友叫她改表演內容時，她不肯。第一輪比賽很折磨人：麥克風一直斷訊，觀眾也越來越不耐煩。Ivy 不服輸地繼續表演，不用麥克風講她的故事。很多其他參賽者的表演很挑釁，甚至粗俗露骨，所以評審覺得她乾淨又好笑得不得了的笑話令人耳目一新。第二輪，評審毫不留情地刷掉一半的表演者。一位對手晉級時得意洋洋地笑著，但他在決賽輸給了 Ivy。

questions.questionZh: 第一輪比賽發生了什麼問題？
options: Ivy 忘了準備好的笑話
評審遲到了半個多小時才開始
觀眾太少，場地幾乎是空的

questions.questionZh: 評審為什麼覺得 Ivy 的笑話特別？
options: 內容都和她小時候的經驗有關
乾淨又好笑，和別人不同

items.promptZh: 回家的那趟飛行又長又折磨人。
referenceEn: The flight home was long and torturous.
The trip home by plane was long and torturous.
rubricZh: 「折磨人的」用 torturous，例如放 be 動詞後（long and torturous）等
「回家的那趟飛行」可寫，例如 the flight home、the trip home by plane 等
時態配合內容（例如 was、is）

items.promptZh: 那匹馬很固執，不肯讓任何人騎。
referenceEn: The horse is headstrong and won't let anyone ride it.
That headstrong horse refuses to let anyone ride it.
rubricZh: 「固執」用 headstrong（例如 is headstrong、that headstrong horse 等）
「不肯」可寫，例如 won't、refuses to 等
時態配合內容；過去式、現在完成式都正確
